admission.justification: One case, parametrised over both canonical enclosure arrangements, protects the refusal and its two exit paths; a copy silently obeyed as authority starts or lands the wrong leaf, which is the cost the requirement records.

applicability: A contract document found at one of the canonical places inside a task folder - a task folder's own series-contract.md or an enclosure's.
conditions: The document records its own place in its series_contract_path cell.
exclusions: A file under notes/, requirements/ or a deeper folder: not a contract at all, so it is never checked and never obeyed.
A folder that holds no contract: nothing to check.
statement: A contract read at a canonical enclosure location must name its own path and is refused with both paths and a remedy when it instead names the master contract.
